capabilities: Matches note names, aliases and paths as you type
Searches every word of every note with ranked previews
Applies filters and scopes to narrow searches
Answers questions by meaning with an on-device model
Explains why a note is or is not found
extras: Free and open source with no telemetry, accounts or payments; index and vectors live in browser IndexedDB outside the vault; benchmarks against Omnisearch, Quick Switcher++, Another Quick Switcher and Smart Connections; mobile works but is not officially supported; Obsidian-only operators (line:, section:, block:, task:, /regex/) are handed to built-in search; requires Obsidian 1.8.0+ on desktop.
intentEvidence: Does it replace Obsidian's search? No. It sits beside it.
motivation: Search is the thing you do a hundred times a day, so a hundred small waits add up; Jet is built so there is no wait.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search is slow on large vaults and quick switchers match only note names, so there is no fast way to find every word of every note.

requires.name: Hugging Face model download (minishlab/potion-base-8M) for optional Search by meaning

summary: Instant offline search that matches note names as you type, indexes every word of every note, and adds filters, scopes and on-device semantic answers.
